description: What US retail pharmacies pay per unit for a menopause medicine and each of its strengths and brands, from CMS's weekly NADAC survey (newest week, and the week before when it moved). A pharmacy's cost, not a price a person pays. Accepts a treatment or a product word, e.g. "estradiol patch", "Prometrium", "Veozah".
name: menopause_pharmacy_cost_nadac
title: What pharmacies pay (CMS NADAC)
